CHANGELOG


-----------------


pre V1.6.4: Lost :(

V1.6.4: Changes to A-120 and A-200, and a few bugfixes

V1.6.5: Updated A-60's sprites, Changed A-60's table mechanic, Removed A-100's wall collision, and overhauled charms.

V1.7.0: Added Safezones and Checkpoints, Changed A-120's rebounding and visuals, changed some sounds

V1.7.1: Added Kalypto's sounds

V1.7.5: Updated A-90's detection, now he detects mouse movement, Overhauled A-120 and A-200's visuals, Made A-900 become a lot more intense, changed many death screen visuals.

V1.7.6: Changed A-40's visuals and death screen, Changed A-100's death screen

V1.7.7: Added the scanner, still in development, and may be very buggy.

V1.8.0: A-1000 and cutscene for it, Scanner finished and ready, added anticheat and red-skull, slightly changed A-120's rebounding

V1.8.2: Added visual variation for all prime variants, A-60 prime has sharper teeth, A-90 prime is more pixelated and slightly taller, A-200 prime has a stitched mouth A-120 and A-200 can now friendly fire against A-100, Changed How A-60 attacks

V1.8.3: Added charm of patience, made checkpoint skipping cooler, allowing to gear up before the checkpoint, made new locker safety mechanics, made A-200 prime slower

V1.8.5: Added battery picking up animations, Added battery snatching, hold space when picking up batteries, it takes stamina though, Added Gluttony charm animations

V1.8.6: Changed sound for slamming Pnevma, Fixed a few things with the mouse cursor when the player is animating.

V1.8.8: Fixed A-60 Prime's Catalyst Timing, Re-Worded Scanner's A-100 Message, Fixed The Gummy Scanner.

V1.8.9: Fixed A-60 and A-60 Prime's Killing with Patience, Changed Locker entering for Catalyst Timing, Added Stamina Overflow indicator, Changed Catalyst Timings, Changed A-200 and A-120's kill mechanics.

V1.9.0: Fixed A-50, Changed A-50's visuals

V1.9.1: Changed A-120's Rebound Distance, Fixed Batteries When Skipping, Fixed Getting Desire When Skipping To A-100

V1.9.2: Added a limit to Catalyst Timings

V1.9.5: Overhauled how A-60 Busts doors, Added Falling Behind, Changed A-60, A-120 and A-200 Spawn Positions, Updated A-200's Jumpscare

V1.9.6: Fixed A-60 Prime's flicker, Fixed A-60 Prime Not Spawning on Room A-60, Changed Flashlight Flickering Visual, Fixed A-120 and 200 Spawning during an A-60 attack

V1.9.7: Changed A-120's visuals, Changed A-120 and A-200's sounds

V1.9.8: Made anticheat less strict.

V1.9.9: Made Gummylight last a bit longer, and warding A-50 off with gummylight requires near full battery and takes a lot more battery away, Changed Catalyst Effect, changed catalyst timings, added more screenshakes FINALLY FIXED SAVE DATA ANTICHEAT PROBLEM

V2.0.0: ADDED CUSTOM FPS SUPPORT (still in beta)

V2.0.1: fixed a few bugs with Delta Time

V2.0.2: changed A-120's appearance slightly

V2.0.3: Changed A-200's Sounds and Added A-200 Idle Sound

V2.1.0: Overhauled A-1000 Cutscene and Changed how the Title Screen Displays BackGrounds

V2.1.3: Changed some of the Guest's dialogue and added new mechanics to his dialogue, made his portal look more glow-ey and added an animation to him, prevented the player from grabbing the gummylight if they already have the scanner as well

V2.1.5: Made A-60 Prime A lot more seamless, it still waits for any current A-60 or A-60 prime to despawn, but it instead determines whether one should spawn on the first frame that A-60 breaks a door, Also fixed A-200's constant audible exhaling, and fixed A-250's audio, Changed A-60's Spawn Rules

V2.1.6: Made A-60 spawn a little less frequently, Made A-60 slower Pre A-50, Fixed Gummy Light Not Flickering while Hiding

V2.2.0: Added lot's of scripts controlling volume

V2.2.1: Added new sounds for A-60

V2.2.2: Added tension, updated table visual

V2.2.3: fixed A-60 prime bug, where it gave the scanner temporarily

V2.2.4: Added UI slider for Color and a button for Checkpoints, Upgraded Greed's A-40 warning

V2.3.0: Added deaf mode!

V2.3.3: Nerfed A-120 and A-200, Changed some room types, Updated battery spawn locations adding a secondary spawn for most rooms, fixed deaf mode A-60 not showing

V2.3.4: Nerfed A-60 past A-500

V2.3.5: Further Nerfed A-120 and A-200, along with adding a Delay in rooms before they can spawn again

V2.3.6: Nerfed A-60 Prime's Spawnrate, Fixed Scanner Not Having Static Sound When A-60 Prime Is Coming

V2.3.7: Buffed A-200 Spawnrate, Nerfed A-90 Spawnrate

V2.4.0: Nerfed A-60 past A-900, Slightly Buffed A-200, Fixed Catalyst Timing A-60

V2.4.3: Slightly buffed Scanner battery life, Fixed slamming A-1000 door, Fixed A-60 Breaking A-1000 door, Buffed A-50, A-120, and A-200 Spawnrates

V2.5.0: A-120 now pushes you back to the entrance of the room, Fixed Red Skull again, Made Patience Catalyst times more strict
A-90 no longer can spawn randomly, A-60 is a bit faster before A-60

V2.5.1: A-60's light now shrinks after hitting the door like in the actual game, fixed A-120 glitching you if it teleports you while in a locker, recharging batteries now delays interaction, you can no longer recharge flashlight with 1 battery

V2.5.2: Removed Tension functionality entirely, Made A-60' arrive faster

V2.5.3: Added new Ambience, Changed the Death Notes

V2.5.4: Fixed A-60's sound being audible for a few frames after A-60 spawns, Fixed slamming the Lever room door when it was locked, made a few adjustments to deaf mode.
